title: KVCOMM: Online Cross-context KV-cache Communication for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
authors: Hancheng Ye; Zhengqi Gao; Mingyuan Ma; Qinsi Wang; Yuzhe Fu; Ming-Yu Chung; Yueqian Lin; Zhijian Liu; Jianyi Zhang; Danyang Zhuo; Yiran Chen

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM systems suffer from significant prefilling overhead due to redundant recomputation of overlapping contexts across agents, which is exacerbated by diverging prefixes that prevent standard KV-cache reuse.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM 系統因 agents 間重疊 context 的冗餘重計算而產生顯著的 prefilling 開銷，且不同前綴的發散進一步阻礙了標準 KV cache 的重用。

key_innovation.en: KVCOMM, a training-free framework that enables efficient prefilling by reusing KV-caches and aligning cache offsets of overlapping contexts using an online-updated anchor pool of observed cache deviations.
key_innovation.zh: KVCOMM 是一個免訓練框架，藉由重用 KV cache 並利用線上更新的 anchor pool（記錄已觀察到的 cache 偏移量）來對齊重疊 context 的快取偏移，從而實現高效率的 prefilling。

key_improvements.en: Up to 7.8x speedup in prefill pipeline, 6.7x average prefill speed-up, 70% reuse rate, and minimal accuracy degradation (less than 2.5% drop).
key_improvements.zh: prefill pipeline 速度最高提升 7.8x，平均 prefill 加速 6.7x，KV cache 重用率達 70%，精度損失極低（低於 2.5%）。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Math reasoning, Programming tasks
